run_qc.help_text: Run QC (human read removal, fastp trimming, sylph profiling) on paired short reads. When false, reads pass through unchanged.

preproc_read_suffix.help_text: Suffix for QC'd read file names (e.g. <ID>_preprocessed_1.fastq.gz).

host_removal.help_text: Which samples get bowtie2 human read removal: auto (every sample except reads from iRODS, which NPG has already depleted), all or none.

host_bowtie2_index.help_text: bowtie2 index of the human reference (NPG's T2T-CHM13v2.0 by default).

fastp_options.help_text: Options passed to fastp, matched to the previous Trimmomatic defaults (SLIDINGWINDOW:4:20 CROP:151 MINLEN:70).

fastp_trim_poly_g.help_text: Force polyG tail trimming (fastp -g). Set to false to disable it (-G).

save_individual_fastp_reports.help_text: Publish the per-sample fastp JSON and HTML reports into <outdir>/<ID>/fastp/.

sylph_profile.help_text: Run sylph taxonomic profiling on the QC'd reads.

sylph_k.help_text: k-mer size for sylph sketches (21 or 31).

sylph_profile_options.help_text: Extra options for sylph profile (-u: estimate the unknown fraction).

sylph_profile_batch_size.help_text: Number of samples profiled per sylph profile job; the database is loaded once per batch.

qc_multiqc_report.help_text: Make one MultiQC report of the bowtie2 human alignment, fastp and sylph-tax results across all samples, in <outdir>/multiqc.

qc_report_name.help_text: MultiQC report name; the file is <date>-<qc_report_name>.html.

qc_multiqc_config.help_text: MultiQC config used for the QC report (sample naming and section order).
